episodes.title: How can AI kill us all? Eight existential risk scenarios with Prof. Geoffrey Hinton
episodes.description: Hinton delivers the keynote at an Existential Risk Observatory event laying out eight ways AI could cause human extinction, followed by a panel and audience Q&A.

episodes.title: Sam Altman on Jensen Huang, Anthropic’s IPO, And Growing AI Backlash | Future Proof
episodes.description: Altman talks to Semafor's Reed Albergotti about Jensen Huang's ouster from Nvidia, Anthropic's IPO, the data-center backlash, and whether OpenAI should go public.

episodes.title: AI Memorized the Internet. That's Not Intelligence. | Yann LeCun
episodes.description: LeCun argues that language models merely memorized the internet, makes the case for open, shared world models, and explains why he is building machines that learn how the world works.

episodes.title: Geoffrey Hinton: AI Learns Like a Child (Then Outgrows Us)
episodes.description: Hinton explains how neural networks learn from noisy labels the way children do, and why he believes we are creating alien beings whose psychology we need to understand.

episodes.title: Sam Altman and Greg Brockman on the Next Next Thing
episodes.description: Altman and Brockman sit down with Andrew Ross Sorkin at the 2026 DealBook Summit to discuss alignment, competition for compute, and keeping people in charge as AI grows more powerful.

episodes.title: Geoffrey Hinton on AI's Dangers, Potential Solutions, and His Timeline for Superintelligence
episodes.description: Hinton sits down with Sinead Bovell to unpack how modern AI goes off the rails, why the labs keep racing ahead, and his timeline for superintelligence.

episodes.title: The “Godfather of AI” on the Risks That Worry Him Most | Geoffrey Hinton | TED
episodes.description: Hinton talks with journalist Nicholas Thompson at TEDAI Vienna about the AI risks that worry him most, a best-case future for the technology, and whether chatbots have subjective experience.
